Snam::/job/Milano-Malipiero-Renovit/Adde.experience_required: At least 10 years industrial HVAC/electrical/plumbing maintenance; professional license for thermal systems, plant schematics and on-call availability.

Snam::/job/Milano-Malipiero-Renovit/Ener.salary: Official indicative minimum RAL EUR 42,000 plus annual incentive, potentially proportionated for apprenticeship.
